question: Will Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov visit Florida in December 2026?

calls.reasoning: The G20 leaders' summit is Dec 14-15, 2026 at Trump Doral, Florida; Russia says it will attend 'at a high level' but as of Nov 24 had not named a delegation head, and Putin is undecided. Base rate: Lavrov led Russia's G20 summit delegation in 2022-2024; Oreshkin led it in 2025 (3 of 4 = 75%). Lavrov just went to the Atlanta G20 FM meeting in Oct 2026 despite US sanctions, so entry is possible and his standing looks restored. If Putin goes (~25%), Lavrov almost surely accompanies him; if not, Lavrov leads ~65% (a 2025-style Oreshkin pick is the main risk). Small discount for summit disruption, withdrawn invitation, or health. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
sources: WebSearch results: Oreshkin led Russian delegation at 2025 Johannesburg G20 (TASS/Kremlin/CNN listings)

calls.reasoning: Lavrov can only plausibly be in Florida in December for the G20 leaders' summit (Dec 14-15, Trump National Doral, Miami). As of Nov 24, the Kremlin hasn't decided on Putin attending, and Russia says it will attend 'at a high level' with the delegation head still undecided. Base rate: with Putin absent, Lavrov led Russia's G20 summit delegation in 2022, 2023 and 2024; Oreshkin led in 2025 and Lavrov didn't go. Lavrov did travel to the US for the Atlanta G20 foreign ministers' meeting on Oct 30-31, 2026, so the MFA is engaged this G20 cycle and a US visa isn't a blocker. P(Putin attends) ~0.32 x 0.92 + P(not) ~0.68 x 0.55 = ~0.67, minus ~0.04 for postponement, visa or substitution risk. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
